plotSections.title: Moxie, Ord's New Roommate
bullets: Ciri and Ord meet Moxie, a semi-sentient, amphibious beaver-like creature ("beaverine") living in a hovel in the keep's basement, in Ponchi's quarters and now Ord's.
Ciri feeds Moxie a whole bucket of kitchen scraps; Moxie eats them noisily by the handful, whistling and begging for more.
Moxie offers to hunt for Ord and calls him "handler"; Ord tells her she may hunt only outside the keep and must respect the spaces inside, breaking nothing that isn't hers.
Moxie dives into the keep's dock port and swims out underwater toward the portcullis.

plotSections.title: Regrouping at Langdale Stronghold
bullets: The party has returned to the stronghold to regroup and decide where to go next; earlier, Mahali led a philosophical conversation about gods, the effects and scale of belief, and how one becomes a deity.
Sylan rejoins; Gerk is mashing raw potatoes by punching them in a bucket while Ponchi cuts vegetables and Mahali nearly finishes a pork-inspired stew.
Koji, Bo, and the stone mill mercenaries are holed up in the guard house on patrol duty.
Sylan still holds Ord's fused lantern-staff and wants to continue practicing with it.
The DM reminds the party they still have a lich to find, plus a factory to deal with.

chronologicalEvents: Ciri feeds Moxie a bucket of scraps in the basement.
Ord sets rules for Moxie: hunt outside the keep, respect the keep's spaces.
Moxie, calling Ord "handler," swims off through the dock port toward the portcullis.
Ciri and Ord return to the kitchen, where Gerk is mashing potatoes and Ponchi and Mahali are cooking.
Sylan arrives and is told about Moxie; he confirms he still holds the lantern-staff.
The DM reminds the party of the lich hunt and the factory.

notes: Semi-sentient, amphibious beaver-like creature ("beaverine") newly living in the keep's basement hovel, shared with Ponchi and Ord.
Eats scraps noisily by the handful and whistles while eating.
Offered to hunt for Ord; told to hunt only outside the keep.
Leaves through the dock port, swimming underwater toward the portcullis.
Gained as stronghold staff through a dice roll for stronghold expansion.
personality: Eager, food-motivated, speaks in simple repetitive phrases
openQuestions: Sylan asks whether Moxie could be a spy.

notes: Now shares quarters with Moxie, who calls him "handler."
